name: Planner Cell
description: Autonomous planning cell that discovers available cells, analyzes task complexity, decomposes complex tasks into subplans, and generates execution DAGs with recursive learning from failures

category.description: Cell category - 'ephemeral' marks this as ephemeral (not persisted)

intent.description: User intent in natural language (e.g., 'Create horror boss with animations')

previous_failure.description: Context from previous failure for learning

cells_discovered.description: List of cell IDs that were discovered

cells_to_generate.description: Specifications for cells that need to be generated

status.description: Current status of the planning process

max_depth.description: Maximum recursion depth to prevent infinite loops

_discovery.describe: Autonomous planning cell that discovers available cells through 4-level search (semantic, label, LLM ranking, validation), analyzes task complexity, recursively decomposes complex tasks into manageable subplans, generates execution DAGs, identifies missing cells, and learns from previous failures. Integrates with DiscoveryService for cell discovery and uses OpenInterpreter + Gemini Flash for planning decisions. Supports human-in-the-loop approval via MITM Gate.
use_cases: Transform user intent into executable workflows
Discover and compose existing cells into pipelines
Decompose complex tasks into manageable subplans
Learn from failures and retry with improved approach
